name: godot-mcp
description: Work on Godot 4 projects: edit scenes, nodes and scripts, run the game and read its errors, drive the running game, and look up the offline class reference. Bundles the godot-mcp server and a Godot workflow skill.

project_folder.title: Godot project folder
project_folder.description: Where project.godot is, relative to the folder you start Claude Code in. Leave empty when project.godot is in that folder itself.

godot_path.title: Godot executable
godot_path.description: Full path of your Godot 4 executable (Windows: the main .exe, not _console.exe). Leave empty to find "godot" on PATH. A GODOT_PATH environment variable, if you have one, takes precedence.
